force_password_change.flow: Admin resets password -> must_change_password=true -> Login returns flag -> Frontend blocks routes -> ChangePassword page -> User changes password -> Flag cleared
endpoints: POST /api/users/password-reset - Admin sets new password, sets must_change_password=true
POST /api/auth/login - Returns must_change_password flag when set
POST /api/auth/change-password - User changes password, clears flag
